text:
maria: PR #5623 — compactify cursor-based examples for py/ts/go. Looking for quick eyes on retry semantics and pagination+resume-token flow. https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-docs/pull/5623

devon: skimmed it. Nice shrink. Python still calls old `stream()` API in the pagination sample — should show async iterator + explicit resume token checkpoint.

aj: I can swap the Python snippet to the async iterator pattern and add a small backoff example (exponential+jitter). Will also add a short sync wrapper for users who want blocking calls.

sam: yes please include both sync+async snippets. Also call out TTL for resume tokens (we had a support case last month where people assumed tokens were permanent).

kevin: small ops note: add a docs-ci job that runs snippets via the snippets harness so they don't drift. I can add a job.yaml to the PR.

deploy-bot: docs-ci/job/5623 — failure on go example: "undefined: ResumeToken" at examples/pagination/go/checkpoint.go:24

aj: on it — fixing Go struct name. pushing patch in a min.

aj: (patch pushed) quick snippet of the fix:
```go
// checkpoint.go (trimmed)
type ResumeToken struct {
    Cursor string `json:\"cursor\"`
    Expiry int64  `json:\"expiry_unix\"`
}
```

devon: thanks. also found one broken link in the new doc: `/guides/streaming` -> should point to `/guides/streams` (404 currently).

maria: added link-fix to the PR description and left a note to include a one-line changelog entry about resumed pagination semantics.

sam: quick nit: in the TS example, show a tiny `retryWithBackoff` helper instead of inlining logic everywhere. keeps samples readable.

aj: agreed, will factor it out.

kevin: once CI is green I'll merge. please ping if anyone needs me to run the snippet harness manually.

sam: LGTM from docs side. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks team — aiming to merge by EOD after green CI and the link fix.

[thread end]
